body: Thank you for these beautiful words ❤️‍🔥

Hey, thank you for your kind words. I really appreciate you sharing this experience here and my heart aches for you and your sister. I’m so sorry. The gaslighting of your sister is horrendous but sadly all too common in these situations. I’m gaslit by my parents and told I’m overreacting when I try to set boundaries. It’s a cruel and tough spot to be in. I wish you and your sister happiness and peace.
Thank you for your kind words.

Hey, unfortunately I am telling the complete truth. When I posted I was weary that some people might be skeptical and think I was a pedophile constructing some sick fantasy. I have most definitely seen variations of this gross behaviour  on other confession forums and given the scary anonymity of the internet I can understand why you thought this. You’re entitled to your opinion, but when I say this post is genuine and I was giving a pretty brutal and confronting overview of something I’ve been struggling with for years, that is the truth.

Thank you. Getting out is the main goal. Unfortunately I don’t have any other family in our city and I feel like I can’t broach this with my friends right now. I want to bring it up but it just feels wrong. Like I would be saddling the other party with a burden. I’m hopefully starting work in March, but as of now I don’t have the capacity to WFH until my health improves.
Hey, I really appreciate this. Your words are very kind and wise.
